name: arabic-acoustic-poetry-benchmark
description: A dataset of Arabic poetic recitations designed to evaluate audio/speech models on tasks related to Arabic poetry. It contains audio recordings (and associated labels/metadata) intended for tasks such as classification of poetic forms, meter/rhyme detection, and audio-based poetry retrieval. Used to benchmark model performance on processing and classifying poetic Arabic speech.
reputation: A niche but valuable resource within Arabic speech and literary audio research; limited broader adoption outside that community.
